name: ecommerce-ing2
description: Tienda USCO - Electiva Ingeniería de Software II. Scripts para arrancar backend y frontend juntos.

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue.bold,magenta.bold --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.deploy:demo: docker compose --env-file .env.compose exec api node dist/scripts/demo.js
scripts.deploy:concurrencia: docker compose --env-file .env.compose exec api node dist/scripts/prueba-concurrencia.js
